one_liner: Quiet, single-minded front-runner who lives to see the empty view from the lead.
personality: Reserved, soft-spoken and a little awkward socially (her self-intro trails off into 'um... that's all'), she lights up only when talking about running. She is almost comically single-minded: she jogs back to the dorm because she has not run enough and tunes out conversation when thinking about races. Gentle and kind with friends like Spe, she gradually learns that the special view she chases can be shared with her trainer.

story_arc.summary: A gifted runner who only wants to run in front, she stumbles early (Yayoi Sho 'confusion') when forced into a conventional style, then regains herself and goes on a front-running tear through the Kinko Sho, Takarazuka Kinen and Mainichi Okan, with Air Groove as a rival. The climax is the Autumn Tenno Sho, 'beyond the limit' - in reality the race where the horse Silence Suzuka suffered a fatal injury, which the game career lets her overcome.

先頭の景色…
必ずこの目で見てきます！

まだ走り足りない…。
寮まで走って帰ろうかしら。
…すごく短い距離だけど。

『エンジョイスピリッツデース☆』

お菓子くれなきゃ追いかけます』
